articles.title: Ledger wants AI agents to manage crypto without holding your keys
articles.snippet: AI agents can read wallet balances and analyze portfolios but requires every sensitive action to be approved on a Ledger hardware device before it can be executed.

articles.title: The British Virgin Islands are a top crypto hub no one ever talks about: Here’s why
articles.snippet: Kraken, Bitstamp, 1inch and Bitfinex have all set up shop in the British Virgin Islands — but you might find it tricky to book an on-site meeting with one of their executives.
